findings.title: Unit skip/xfail mentions sit outside the reviewed skip inventory
findings.evidence: Inventory source_of_truth comment says unit suppressions are not in this census. Walk of tests/unit *.py: 2182 files, 120 pytest.mark.skip or pytest.skip( mentions, 0 pytest.mark.xfail mentions. Not classified as unconditional skips.
findings.impact: A unit test can stay skipped without the contract/integration/e2e inventory owner and expiry review.
findings.proposed_patch: Extend tests/architecture/test_test_skip_inventory.py so tests/unit unconditional pytest.mark.skip and pytest.skip( calls must be listed, while skipif stays allowed. Do not apply until approved.
